notes.zh: 审阅注：本事件只是“残酷实验者”(Twisted Experimenters)帝国“实验测试”情境里的随机插曲。A 放走逃犯：获得团结度，并把一半试验品人口群转成难民物种投向难民系统（refugees.1，约65%；35% 另一路径）；B 停工封锁（360 天 testing_lockdown 修正）；C 处决所有试验品作为榜样，并立即结算当前情境（shroud.1010 → 1015 选择下一轮实验）。
notes.en: Review note: this is only a random interlude inside the Experimental Testing situation of Twisted Experimenters empires. A lets the escapees go (unity reward; half of the test-subject pop groups become a refugee species, refugees.1 at about 65%); B locks the facilities down for 360 days; C executes the rest and immediately resolves the situation (shroud.1010 → 1015 chooses the next round).
